newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia Nov pax load factor drops to 68.7 p.
newsitem.headline: Iberia Nov pax load factor drops to 68.7 p.

text.p: Iberia said its passenger load factor dipped to 68.7 percent in November from 74.2 percent in October.

It flew 1.16 million passengers in the month and clocked 2.06 billion revenue passenger kms, taking the total so far this year to 13.54 million passengers (an increase of 6.6 percent on the same period 1995) and 23.90 billion revenue passenger kms (up nearly nine percent on last year).

Cargo carried was up 3.5 percent on the same month last year at 66.22 million freight tonne kms, taking the total in the first 11 months of this year to 660.56 million tonne kms, an increase of 8.4 percent.
November 1995 traffic figures were lower than usual because of a series of pilot strikes last year. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+44-171-542-5017
